$comment: The Oiê brand (design/brand/oie/brand.md): it swaps colour roles and the one type family of the layer that wears it, nothing else (the core's brands rule, check_brands).

oie.name: Oiê
oie.source: Owner's approvals in the Claude session, 2026-11-18: logo coral #E8573C, cream #FFF6EE, ink #2A1714 (01 Brand/logo/README.md); the full palette approved the same day (STATUS.md); Nunito chosen as the one family.

color.usage: Cream paper by day; a warm near-black at night.
White cards on cream; the logo's ink as the dark card.
Warm ink, the logo's dark. 16:1 on page in both themes.
Coral, the logo's colour, in the brand-accent role: one filled action per screen, the frame, the active thing. Fill only, never text (3.4:1 on cream). Ink on it.
Stop and destructive fills (remove a contact, unlink). A deeper brick than the brand coral, always with a word. Text on it is on-stop (product layer).
Stop and error as text: 6.7:1 on page (light), 8.9:1 (dark).
The tint behind error and stop messages.
